targetDataset: ERA5-Land reanalysis; ERA5 fallback at Stock Island (coastal land-grid gap)
features: All inputs use archived 48-hour forecasts; rainfall history is an estimated antecedent, not observed rainfall.
limitations: Soil moisture is a modeled grid-cell proxy, not bearing capacity.
Reanalysis heat targets are not on-site observations.
Four manually selected Mississippi corridor sites have demonstration rainfall screening; floodplain membership is not verified.
Demo day deliberately selected as the hero site’s highest upper HeatCast prediction during July–August; aggregate metrics cover the full test period.

hazardCast.features: Archived 48h GFS daily aggregates, frozen HeatCast/GroundCast upper quantiles, FEMA NFHL and USACE NLD plant traits, NOAA CO-OPS gauge distance
limitations: Labels are official or observed hazard evidence near a plant, not confirmed on-site conditions or injuries.
FIRMS includes prescribed and agricultural burns; fire labels end 2025-12-31 without a FIRMS key.
Scores map probability through documented anchors; learned evidence only raises channel scores.
